name: Warclans
worldbuilding: Tribal confederations, roaming warbands, warrior societies, and armies united by powerful warlords. They rely on aggression, numbers, and the momentum of powerful Charges. Both signature Core choices are Infantry. Their cavalry and ranged troops remain predominantly generic.

factionRule.name: Eager for Battle
factionRule.effect: All friendly Units gain Charge 2. Applicable Charge X values use the highest available rank rather than stacking unless a rule expressly says otherwise. Charge 2 does not increase Impact.

factionCommands.name: Get In There!
factionCommands.effect: When a different friendly Unit successfully completes a Charge, choose one unactivated friendly Unit within Short of the charger. It may immediately make its normal Charge activation, consuming its Assault activation for this Phase; it does not gain a second Charge.

factionCommands.name: Overwhelm
factionCommands.effect: One friendly multi-model Unit gains +1 Attack per Model during its next Combat activation.

factionCommands.name: Keep Fighting!
factionCommands.effect: After destroying an enemy Unit in Engagement, the attacking Unit may Move up to 2" toward another enemy.

factionCommands.name: Crush Their Ranks
factionCommands.effect: Choose one friendly Unit within Short and one of these battlefield-role counters when activating: Anti-Infantry 4 or Anti-Ranged 4. That Unit gains the selected Anti-tag 4 for its next eligible Attack against a Unit actually bearing the matching tag this Round. Applicable Anti ranks never add; use the highest. This is one CP-powered Command and cannot stack with another friendly Command on the same Attack.

abilities.name: Mob Violence
abilities.effect: When Charging with at least six Models remaining, gain Impact +3.

abilities.name: Keep Swinging
abilities.effect: Once per Attack roll, after destroying an enemy Model during that activation, one natural 6 may generate one additional ordinary Hit.

abilities.name: Reckless Charge
abilities.effect: Gain Impact +2 on a successful Charge.

abilities.name: Racing Boars
abilities.effect: This Unit has printed Charge 3, replacing faction Charge 2 when determining Charge distance. This does not add to Charge Impact.

abilities.name: Drive the Mob
abilities.effect: One friendly Infantry Unit within Short gains +2" Move during its next Move but cannot make a ranged Attack during that activation.

abilities.name: Brutal Magic
abilities.effect: Roll 1D6. On 3+, inflict Direct Damage 1 on one visible enemy within Medium.

upgrades.name: Thunderclap
upgrades.effect: Choose one visible enemy Unit within Short Range. Move that Unit up to 2" directly away from the Shaman, maintaining Unit coherency and ending in legal positions. This counts as forced movement and does not count as Disengaging.

abilities.name: Rallying Roar
abilities.effect: Remove Withdrawn from a nearby friendly Unit and add one die to its next Charge Pool this Round.

optionalUpgrades.name: Specialized Guidance
optionalUpgrades.effect: At list construction choose one existing creature/material Trait tag. Other friendly Units wholly within 3" gain Anti-[that tag] 2. Highest applicable Anti rank only. This is a passive aura, not a free Command; does not benefit its source.

abilities.name: Unstable Frame
abilities.effect: On a Blunder, suffer Direct Damage 1.

upgrades.name: Rockfall
upgrades.effect: Instead of making a Boulder Thrower Attack, place a 25mm token within 15". At the end of the Combat Phase, every Unit with at least half its surviving Models (rounded up) within 1" of the token suffers one automatic Physical Hit at Damage 2 total. Resolve Armor then Ward; no Evade. Resolve Saves normally. Remove the token after resolving the effect.

abilities.name: Too Big to Ignore
abilities.effect: Enemy Units cannot benefit from Cover against the Warchief's Attacks.

abilities.name: Warcry
abilities.effect: Up to three friendly Units within Medium gain +1 Impact during their next Charge this Round. One of those Units may also immediately Move up to 2".

genericUnitsWorthTaking: Bow Infantry, Light Cavalry, mounted skirmishing configurations, Medics, and cheap spear formations. This army should not need a unique version of every kind of fighter.
designNotes: v4.2 balance pass: added Boar Riders as the faction's Extra Core, a Charge-focused Cavalry unit reinforcing the aggression/Charge identity rather than patching a weakness. Choppa Mob's Horde Infantry weapon profile was kept unchanged (Models, not Attacks, is this faction's established horde-buff pattern). Other Damage-1 weapons gained +1 Attack; Damage-2+ weapons kept their Attacks and gained a thematic Anti-[Type] (Anti-Elite on the Warboss' Boss Choppa, Anti-Unique on the War Beast's Tusks and Claws) or an improved Hit (Boulder Thrower 5+ -> 4+).
